settings.title: Privacy and your data
settings.intro: Everything you enter is stored on this phone, encrypted, with one exception below. Nothing is shared unless you choose to share it.
settings.downloadBody: Copy your check-ins, choices, reminder settings and next-day check as text you can keep.
settings.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it by hand.
settings.deleteBody: Withdraws what you shared with clinics, deletes the number you gave for reminders and any note you handed to the crisis line, and removes your check-ins, choices and the key that protects them from this phone. This cannot be undone.
settings.deleteConfirm: Delete everything from this phone? This cannot be undone.
settings.deleted: Everything on this phone was deleted.
settings.deleteFailed: Deleting failed. Close other tabs of this app and try again.
settings.unavailable: This browser cannot keep data on this phone, so there is nothing stored here.
settings.exception: The exception: while a crisis screen is open, this browser tab keeps a small note in plain text so that help stays one tap away even if storage fails. It says that the crisis screen was shown, which question set it off, and when. It holds no answers or scores. It is removed when you tell us you are safe, when you delete everything, or when you close the tab. In an anonymous session the tab also keeps a random code in plain text, and the name of that session's encrypted check-in database carries the same code, so that a session can tell its own check-ins from an old one's. The crisis note then also says the session is anonymous. The code holds no answer, score or result, and it is removed when you leave anonymous mode or close the tab.
settings.blocked: We could not reach the server to remove what it holds for you (a referral you sent, what you shared, a reminder number, a note for the crisis line, or a linked screen result), so nothing was deleted. Connect to the internet and try again.
settings.deletedCrisisSent: A crisis record that had not been sent was sent first. It holds no name and no answers.
settings.deletedCrisisLost: A crisis record that had not been sent could not be sent, and was deleted with everything else.
settings.deletedCrisisOpen: A crisis screen was open. It is closed now, and help is still one tap away: use Help now.

anonymous.banner: Anonymous session: nothing is sent to a server or kept on one.
anonymous.homeBody: Check in and see your results without anything leaving this phone. No ticket, and nothing shared with a clinic.
anonymous.title: Anonymous mode
anonymous.introOff: In an anonymous session the app makes no contact with any server at all. You can still check in, see your results and reach the crisis numbers.
anonymous.introOn: You are in an anonymous session. The app is making no contact with any server.
anonymous.works1: Check-ins, with their results and trend
anonymous.works2: Help now and every crisis number, with no connection needed, as always
anonymous.cannot1: No ticket: you cannot be matched with a service or send a referral
anonymous.cannot2: Nothing is shared with a clinic, a clinician or the crisis line
anonymous.cannot3: Nothing is kept on a server: no account, no reminders, no follow-up
anonymous.keeps: Your check-ins stay on this phone, encrypted, for this browser tab only. They are erased when you leave anonymous mode or delete everything, and anything a closed tab left behind is erased the next time the app starts. If a crisis screen opens, a small encrypted record that it was shown stays on this phone, so help is still there next time. It is never sent anywhere.
anonymous.leaveConfirm: Leave anonymous mode? The check-ins from this session will be erased from this phone. Help now stays available.
anonymous.wallTitle: Not available in an anonymous session
anonymous.wallBody: This needs a ticket or the server, and an anonymous session has neither. Your check-ins and the crisis numbers still work.
anonymous.resultNote: You are in an anonymous session, so there are no support options or tickets here. Leave anonymous mode to be matched with a service.
anonymous.settingsBody: The app makes no contact with any server in this session, so reminders, the equity group totals and the note for the crisis line are not available here.
anonymous.deleteBody: Erases the check-ins of this anonymous session and the small crisis record from this phone. Nothing was sent to a server, so there is nothing to withdraw. This does not touch what was saved outside an anonymous session: leave anonymous mode first to delete that.
